hook: Other fantasy apps charge sixty-five dollars a year for this... War Room does it for free.
finder: Trade Finder searches every roster in your league. Deals up to five players a side, that help both teams.
redzone: Red Zone. Every game live, and exactly which of your players are on the field right now.
odds: Ten thousand simulated seasons. Your playoff odds, every single week.
weather: Wind, rain and cold are baked into every projection. Then one tap sets your best lineup.
recap: And a forty-five second recap video of your week, made right on your phone. Send it to the group chat.
cta: War Room. Any ESPN or Sleeper league. Free... Link in bio.
